response.sql:
WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(s.modindex) AS overall_avg_modindex
  FROM signals s
  INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
telescope_weather_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    t.telescregistry,
    o.weathprofile,
    AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modindex,
    AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshift
  FROM signals s
  INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    twg.telescregistry,
    twg.weathprofile,
    twg.avg_modindex,
    twg.avg_phaseshift
  FROM telescope_weather_groups twg
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE twg.avg_modindex > oa.overall_avg_modindex
),
per_weather_result AS (
  SELECT 
    fg.weathprofile,
    AVG(fg.avg_modindex) AS weather_avg_modindex,
    AVG(fg.avg_phaseshift) AS weather_avg_phaseshift
  FROM filtered_groups fg
  GROUP BY fg.weathprofile
)
SELECT 
  pw.weathprofile,
  pw.weather_avg_modindex,
  pw.weather_avg_phaseshift,
  (pw.weather_avg_modindex - oa.overall_avg_modindex) AS above_overall_avg
FROM per_weather_result pw
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
ORDER BY pw.weathprofile;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average modulation index is calculated across all linked signals (the arithmetic mean of raw signal modindex values), not as the mean of per-group averages.
The phrase 'how far above the overall average they are on average' refers to the difference (weather_profile_avg_modindex - overall_avg_modindex), computed once per weather profile.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average modulation index is the mean of the (telescope, weather_profile) group averages, not the mean of all raw signal values.
